question: Does large learned relational foundation knowledge improve discovery of previously UNSEEN multi-parent causal operators from actual interventions over equal-information conventional and symbolic controls, with intact cold retention?
hypothesis: A tokenless native learner that builds reusable relationship knowledge from 256 prior worlds can improve sample efficiency and full-process cost when it must construct previously unseen 3-parent operators (MUX3, MAJ3) rather than select a supplied familiar two-operator composition. The controls all get exactly the same prior observations and response opportunities; this is uncertain and may fail.
predecessor_evidence: Issue #1088 conditional integration objective, not an integration grant.

FKP-01 PR #1089 qualified development source and G29 Windows+Linux at a8d11478d610bf64b6ed0353368990627d346bae, but source-only identifiability audit indicates exact symbolic succeeds after 3/16 observed actions; NO_GO for claimed novel-rule learning.
AAI-01 PR #1018 ties conventional and exact symbolic on supplied two-route compositions.
ST9 PR #1087 learned within known GF2 quadratic grammar; fully trained active conventional controls tied; new-family cold transfer failed.
WSP #910 is direct modular learned-weight program; cannot assume a proposed mechanism is native-integrated.

inputs.name: FKP02-SRC-V1 frozen synthetic source protocol fingerprint (NOT source code)

seeds.foundation: 10000..10255 inclusive: 256 training-source worlds, 64 public action/outcome episodes each
seeds.primary: 1000..1063 inclusive, 64 untouched worlds, exactly 32 MUX3, 32 MAJ3
seeds.negative: 2000..2015 inclusive, fourth-order parity and memory-dependent laws, NOT listed as foundation/held answer family; evaluation only
seeds.retention: 3000..3015 inclusive, disjoint ordered interference/cohort worlds; test same persistent state pre/post

frozen_design.split: 16 binary input concepts; 4 public binary effect concepts; each world has four hidden output-level causal rules. In foundation, each hidden effect uses AND2, OR2, XOR2, or NAND2 over two unknown input parents; in DEV/primary each effect uses MUX3 (conditional selector and two data inputs) or majority3 of three unknown parents, with half worlds each novel family. Source oracle chooses parents and gates using owner-private HMAC output for protected worlds; no hidden rule or parent identity is supplied to any learner. DEV uses disjoint non-secret key and is never counted as scientific primary.
frozen_design.ordering: Public-only seeded generator provides 64 *unique* uniformly sampled 16-bit intervention vectors per world. The first 16 are genuine paid action/outcome pairs for every arm; 48 additional consequences can be exposed only in development SOURCE IDENTIFIABILITY AUDIT, not original first-use training. Independently sample 128 unique cold held vectors disjoint from all 64 actions. All intervention selection happens before any consequence is revealed; held consequences remain evaluator-only. No post-outcome action selection. Both foundation and subsequent-world data and action orders are identical for all arms; capacity/observations counted.
frozen_design.data_budget: Foundation: 256 worlds x64 actual interventions = 16,384 training action/consequence pairs with 65,536 observed binary outcomes. Subsequent DEV/primary: 16 genuine interventions per new world, 4 effect bits each (64 observed effect bits); 128 unseen state/effect held probes/world for prediction only. No held answer admitted into training. 48 extra DEV probes are for source identifiability audit, NEVER scored as a learner training opportunity.
frozen_design.compute_budget: For each new world at most 16 actual consequence queries/arm; independently account for every foundation update/fit, native program rule induction, posterior candidate enumeration, temporary caches, search iterations, wall+CPU time, serialized bytes and peak RSS. Same-data cost-matched comparison to fully trained conventional learners; unbudgeted exact Bayesian/symbolic learner additionally reported as ceiling (do not confuse uncapped oracle with matched-resource model). Freeze exact learned-parameter/capacity and optimization budgets in source-code commit before a protected first-use, report any budget breach as invalid.
frozen_design.capacity: 256 historic worlds and 16,384 historical episodes shared, 16 input concepts x4 output effects, 4 gates in prior experience, 2 unseen three-input gates in prospective task. Need same fit-data and explicit persistent learned state budget/bytes in all compared arms. No hidden target-program table, source seed, original rule label or HMAC secret in model.
frozen_design.evaluator: Cold prediction accuracy over 128 entirely unseen 16-bit interventions per world, with 4 observed effect bits per intervention; Brier calibration/abstention secondary, family-stratified, paired by world. Source-private targets only in independently governed evaluator. Full process includes foundation construction/fit and cold-state restoration/interference. Source-only identifiability audit may use only DEV worlds 200..215.
frozen_design.stage0_source_identifiability_gate: Before any scientific first-use, demonstrate using DEV worlds only: strongest admitted MUX3/MAJ3 exact-family posterior with 16 public action consequences shows a >=0.02 absolute accuracy gap from its 64-action version over 128 held public inputs, with mean 64-action cold accuracy >=0.98 and >=4/16 DEV worlds having >1 observationally consistent complete functional hypothesis after 16 actions. If not, STOP/SOURCE_DEV_HEADROOM_NO_GO and do not open primary; never tune after primary exposure.
frozen_design.stage1_preprimary_custody: Commit actual independent source, reference evaluator, verified program and baselines, exact source/seed/split/held data fingerprints, proof of private owner-key isolation, resource caps, metric thresholds, and full Linux/Windows build/test before protected science. Protected key must be absent from GitHub code, workflow/job logs, and ChatGPT model prompts. A Python module attribute check is not by itself a secrecy boundary.

controls: A: same historic observations and new-world actions but NO structured relational persistence; equal storage plus sham initialization.

B: native-style structured concept/relation memory learned ONLY from public foundation action/consequence; incremental construction of previously unseen 3-parent operators based on subsequent real action consequences; no source-provided operator lookup IDs.
C: all 16,384 historic episodes and the identical 16 new-world consequences stored flat without relational linkage; same memory budget and equal opportunity to reconstruct links.
D: preserved number/volume of prior episodes but shuffled output associations (negative control); identical query inputs and random seed accounting.
B with learned relation links ablated, no-growth, no-replay, memory erase, and reinitialization-with-same-data negative controls.

Independent exact Bayesian/symbolic posterior enumerating 3-parent MUX and majority allowed family with same first16 observations (information ceiling), plus exact matching with 64 DEV actions solely to verify headroom.

Independent fully trained conventional neural, decision tree, and regularized polynomial/Boolean reference with identical foundation data, new-world observations, expressive family, calibrated convergence and disclosed total cost; if a control fails convergence, science classification INVALID until comparator qualified.
Strong negative worlds: unseen fourth-order parity and delayed state; source/evaluation negative outcomes cannot be learned via target-family enumeration.
metrics: Source DEV headroom: exact Bayesian 16-action vs 64-action held prediction gap over 16 DEV worlds and 128 disjoint states, plus functional ambiguity after 16 actions; source-only audit is not Yggdrasil learning.
Primary blinded 64-world 128-unseen-state full four-effect vector accuracy and per-effect Brier, with separated MUX3/MAJ3 cohorts.
Paired clustered 10,000-draw bootstrap 95% CI using fixed seed 9090 and family stratification; measure vs strongest adequately trained same-information, cost-matched control.
Foundation sensitivity: B vs C identical facts, B vs A sham, D shuffled and no-growth/erasure, 16-intervention inference vs 4/8/12 prefixes.

Cold restored checkpoint predictions and exactly 16 interference worlds / source queries, preservation of earlier factual links and held-world rule, rule invention vs catalog search explicitly distinguished.
End-to-end total CPU, wall time, input actions, memory/storage and per-phase fit/inference cost for ALL controls, including prior 16,384 experiences; no partial pipeline speed claims.

classification_rules.supported: RESEARCH_CANDIDATE_ONLY if passed stage0 and preprimary source/custody controls, and B exceeds the strongest fully trained cost-matched baseline by >=0.05 absolute vector accuracy on BOTH new operator families with paired 95% lower CI >0, OR ties strongest within 0.005 accuracy on BOTH while <=0.5x fully measured total cost; AND B beats C by >=0.05 absolute on at least one family or <=0.5x cost at <=0.005 accuracy loss; AND same-model previous knowledge retention loss <=0.01, no leakage/false confident negative and all controls valid. Independent disjoint-source replication remains mandatory before SCIENTIFIC_PASS.
classification_rules.mixed: Valid source with B above C but not strongest fully fitted/likelihood control, or only one family passes, or regression/cold retention fails => MIXED_DEV, no native integration.
classification_rules.negative: Stage0 headroom failure => SOURCE_DEV_HEADROOM_NO_GO; otherwise valid B tie/loss/failed prespecified positive threshold => NEGATIVE, preserve outcome and do not replay consumed cohorts as fresh.
classification_rules.invalid: Protected first-use before source/evaluator pin, any learner reading HMAC key/private evaluator, wrong held input exclusion, deterministic source drift, test leakage, missed convergence, unequal actions/prior information/fit budget, nonqualified control, absence of stage0, stale SHA, missing whole-process time or inconsistent checkpoint => INVALID; stop without retune claims.
classification_rules.integration: No automatic native merge or main edit. If and only if independent disjoint-source beneficial science is established, implement minimum actual native Yggdrasil substrate/learned-weight change (not just contributor code), complete exact candidate full Windows/Linux regression and independent G29, prove running model's retained gain and owner acceptance. Otherwise main unchanged.

prohibited_after_primary_run: accepted ref mutations without separate owner qualification
preregistration_note: Commit this protocol alone before source/results. No primary run, no native main model or owner runner. No open of original primary first-use until independent qualification and separate operator-scoped evaluation custody. This is follow-on to FKP-01 DEV NO_GO and Issue #1088.
